title: HP reports Q4 revenue up 9.3% YoY to $16B, above $15.3B est., gives "prudent" fiscal 2027 guidance above estimates, and says AI PCs reached ~60% of shipments (Dina Bass/Bloomberg)
summary: Dina Bass / Bloomberg: HP reports Q4 revenue up 9.3% YoY to $16B, above $15.3B est., gives “prudent” fiscal 2027 guidance above estimates, and says AI PCs reached ~60% of shipments — HP Inc. gave a profit forecast for the current year that will likely exceed analysts' estimates …
